policy: Published membership (Prob>=0.5, the authors' reliable-member cut) via the official Gaia DR3-Hipparcos-2 best neighbour. Parallax-space combination of the Hipparcos parallax with a prior centred on the drawn cluster; width sqrt(r50^2 + centre uncertainty^2). Members in >3 sigma tension, curated core stars, stellar-system components and existing host estimates keep their positions.
limitations: r50 contains only half of the members and is used as a conventional prior width, not a measured depth. Very bright stars without usable Gaia membership and stars outside Hipparcos are not covered.
